ui.helpWallpaperQ: The scenery doesn't follow my desktop icons. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: {app} learns where your icons are from Finder through the macOS Accessibility permission. Until that is allowed, the scene is drawn as if the desktop were empty.
ui.helpWallpaperStep1: Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Turn on {app}. If it is already on but icons are still ignored (this happens after the app is rebuilt), remove it with “–” and add it again.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Choose Reload from the {app} menu bar icon.
